title: ISO 3166-1 Country, ISO 4217 Currency, and ISO 10383 Market Identifier Codes
text: isocountry: ISO 3166-1 country codes UN M49 regions membership OECD, European Union (EU), euro area (EMU), European Economic Area (EEA). isocurrency: ISO 4217 currency codes minor units countries using currency. isocurrency_historic: withdrawn ISO 4217 currency codes, e.g. national currencies replaced euro. isomic: ISO 10383 market identifier codes (MICs) exchanges trading venues. Across datasets, country_code ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (alpha_2 isocountry) country_number numeric code, datasets join easily. Use tibble::as_tibble() data.table::.data.table() prefer tibbles data.tables.

title: isocountry (development version)
text: datasets now plain data frames instead tibbles, package longer depends tibble. Use tibble::as_tibble() prefer tibbles. isocountry’s country_code column (ISO numeric code) renamed country_number match isocurrency isocurrency_historic. country_code now always means ISO alpha-2 code. isocurrency now built official ISO 4217 lists published SIX instead iban.com. gains currency_minor_unit column number decimal places, country_name now matches names isocountry (e.g. “Bahamas” instead “Bahamas ()”). New isocurrency_historic dataset withdrawn ISO 4217 currency codes, e.g. national currencies replaced euro. New isomic dataset ISO 10383 market identifier codes (MICs) exchanges trading venues.
